svg.text: Pictogram Figure look: every kind, variant and pose (dashed red = figureQuad)
Pose change (14 frames, every joint eased): stand to sit at frames 0, 3, 7, 10, 14; then sit to lie
Stride cycle (lean pose, phase 0 to 2 pi in eight steps), man then woman, flip = facing left in the last two
Default variants (no variant given: chosen from the anchor, so a row is mixed and stable), and the stroke look for comparison (right)
